title: Waving back at someone who wasn't waving at you

narrator.style: clear, clean, crisp studio voice with precise articulation, smooth, not breathy, not raspy; dry deadpan narrator, slightly unimpressed, natural pace

theo.style: clear, clean voice, not breathy, not raspy; cheeky young guy roasting his friend, trying not to laugh

lines.say: Someone waves at you from across the street.
You have no idea who that is.
But you're not a monster. So you wave back.
Full arm. Like you're landing a fucking airplane.
Then the guy behind you waves back too.
You turn the wave into scratching your head, like a confused monkey.
And of course, Theo saw everything.
Bro. You absolute clown. This is going in the group chat.
It's already in the group chat.
Mia replies with seven skull emojis.
Your own mom replies: who is this dumbass?
Then Theo looks at you, and waves.
And this time, you wave back with one finger.
